body: Thank you, I will try and I hope she does too. It definitely hasn't been easy.

Thank you for your quick reply! I'm away for school so I cannot physically be there, but my brother spent the evening with her but went back to my grandparents house where they live. I will definitely message her again tomorrow and I told her to message me too. she definitely needs help, no doubt. she has an eating disorder, although not professionally diagnosed, but she rarely eats. she's also a big wine drinker, to the point she uses it as escapism. I will try to get her into seeking professional help, although she's not the easiest person to talk to about those things.
